Eve: Quick flag before we go live — demo order needs swapping: do demo after roadmap, not before. That will affect slide timing. Anyone able to patch presenter order?
Jon: I can flip the presenter order in Slides. Will push new deck in ~45s.
Priya: Ops: rehearsal showed a 60s gap in the recorder when switching scenes. I'll start a local fallback recorder and keep an eye on encoder drops.
StreamBot: scene-swap applied to slides-node-1 :white_check_mark: 
Priya: Starting fallback recorder:
recorder start --session allhands-live-0326 --dest /mnt/recs/ah-0326-fallback.mp4
RecorderBot: recorder started (id: rec-2211)
Jon: Uploaded new deck: https://drive/slides/allhands-0326-v2.pptx
Eve: Thanks. Can we add a 20s buffer between roadmap and demo so captions can catch up?
Priya: Will add caption resync right after the roadmap. ETA 10s.
Mia (CEO): Good call. We'll mention the reorder at the start and reserve 5 minutes extra for live Qs on Dedicated capacity and pricing. @Product: be ready for pricing breakdown.
Jon: Deck updated to indicate "Demo will follow Roadmap (start +20s buffer)" on slide 2.
Eve: Perfect. Priya, any sign of encoder instability now?
Priya: Encoder stable. No frame drops in last check. Fallback recorder running.
Eve: OK moving to live. If audio or drops happen, ping this thread and I'll mute the stream and switch to backup.
StreamBot: going-live in 10s...
RecorderBot: upload queued, will attach to INF-612 after session.
Mia (CEO): Thanks everyone — team, quick note: we'll take top 4 Qs at the end, and the dedicated autoscaler mention is "in design".
Eve: Closing thread and monitoring live. Good luck!
